title: Reply to @jackyjonka #everybodystalkinaboutjamie
transcript: so I've seen versions of this comment here as well as an Instagram by the way you can follow me on Instagram — link’s in my bio and I think what we're taking for granted is it's very rare to see an open openly flamboyant gay kid be proud of who they are and have confidence in who they are and I think the version of jamie presented in the show has a lot of confidence and also has a lot of self doubt that they camouflage through confidence also we have to keep in mind that jamie is 16 years old in the show and who wasn't insufferable at 16 years old I know I sure was and to me what's beautiful about everybody's talking about jamie is in the final third of the show jamie does mature and realizes it's not all about me he realizes he wouldn't be where he is without his community that supported him unquestionably all this time and telling that type of story I think it's pretty cool
